pharmacyConnect.title: Connect your pharmacy software
pharmacyConnect.subtitle: Keep the system you already use. The connector reads whatever your software can export and pushes changes to PharmaLink; your product codes stay yours.
pharmacyConnect.loadError: Could not load the connection settings.
pharmacyConnect.keyIssueFailed: Only the pharmacy owner can issue integration keys.
pharmacyConnect.revokeConfirm: Revoke {keyId}? Any software using it will stop syncing immediately.
pharmacyConnect.eachStepChecked: Each step is checked against real data, not a tick box — so "done" always means it actually works.
pharmacyConnect.secretShownOnce: The secret is shown once. Copy it into the connector config now — there is no endpoint that can retrieve it again.
pharmacyConnect.issueKeyHint: Issue one, then paste it into the connector's config file.
pharmacyConnect.name: Name
pharmacyConnect.signedRequestsNote: Every request is signed, so no password travels and a captured request cannot be replayed or re-pointed at another endpoint.
pharmacyConnect.mappingHint: One-time mapping per code. Obvious names are matched automatically; the rest need a single choice from you, and then your software syncs untouched forever.
pharmacyConnect.codesAppearHint: Codes appear here after the connector's first sync.
pharmacyConnect.webhooksHint: Get a signed HTTP POST to your own software when something happens on the platform (a new order, a stock sync completing), instead of polling for changes.
pharmacyConnect.connectorDescription: A single Python file with no dependencies. It runs on the counter PC, reads your existing export (CSV or a read-only database query), and pushes only what changed.
pharmacyConnect.stockReconciledNote: Stock is reconciled to whatever level your software reports, and the difference is written as a stock movement — so your ledger still explains every change.
